book.name: San Mateo
book.title: DIŽAꞋ GÜEN DANꞋ BZOJ SAN MATEO

content: Juan ben' bzoa beṉe' nis gwdix̱jue'ede' diža' güen c̱he Diosen'
Na' gwde zan iz, Juan ben' bzoa beṉe' nis gwyeje' latje daš gan' mbane distritw Judean'.
Na' gwdix̱jue'ede' beṉe', gože' ḻegaque': ―Ḻe yetiṉje xtoḻa'le ca', ḻe ba bžin ža cate' Diosen' ben' zoa yaban' ṉabi'e yic̱hjlaždao' beṉe' yosozenague' c̱he'.
C̱he Juanṉa' bzoj da' Isaíasen' caten' bzoje' Xtiža' Diosen' cani', gwne':

content.text: Bena' chṉe' zižje latje dašen', že':
“Ḻe gonšagüe' yic̱hjlažda'olen' cont soale lez gwzenagle c̱he X̱anchon' cate' yide'.
Ḻe cuejyic̱hj da' malen' chonḻe cont yic̱hjlažda'olen' gaquen ca to nez da' ba gosonšagüe'.”

content: Na' Juanṉa', xaḻane' goquen de yiša' xa camello. Na' da' bc̱hej ḻsinen' goquen de yid, na' gwdagüe' biše'zo len šina' beser yix̱e'.

Beṉe' že' ciuda Jerusalénṉa' na' beṉe' že' yogo' yež ca' gan' mbane distritw Judean', na' ḻecze beṉe' že' yež ca' nyec̱hj mbi'i yegw Jordánṉa' gosa'aque' ja'aque' gan' zoa Juanṉa' cont bosozenague' xtiže'na'.
Na' cate' gosex̱oadoḻe' bi da' xiṉj zjanone', Juanṉa' bzoe' ḻegaque' nis ḻo yegw Jordánṉa'.

Na' ḻecze ja'ac zan beṉe' Israel beṉe' ca' zjanzi' fariseo na' beṉe' ca' zjanzi' saduseo. Ja'aque' cont bzoa Juanṉa' ḻegaque' nis. Nach Juanṉa' cate' ble'ede' ḻegaque' gože'ne': ―¡Ḻe'e nacchguale beṉe' zgot na' beṉe' gwxiye'! ¿Chaquele guac yelale lao castigw dan' seḻa' Diosen' caten' gone' yeḻa' justis c̱he beṉac̱hen'?
Še da' ḻi ba betiṉjele xtoḻa'len', cheyaḻa' gonḻe da' nac güen cont yesacbe'e beṉe' ba boša' yic̱hjlažda'olen'.

Na' bitw gonḻe xbab gaquele Diosen' bitw gone' le'e castigw c̱he xtoḻa'len' lagüe dan' nacle xi'iṉ diaža c̱he da' Abrahanṉa'. Bitw ṉacho ḻeca chyažje Diosen' le'e. Guac gone' cont yej quinga yesyeyaquen xi'iṉ diaža c̱he da' Abrahanṉa'.
Ca nac le'e, še bi chonḻe can' chazlaže' Diosen', zaca'leble ca to yag frut da' bibi chbia. Na' yogo'te yag frut da' bibi chbia, c̱hog x̱an yaga' ḻen na' gwzeyen'.

Neda' da' ḻi chzoa' le'e nis ṉec̱he ba betiṉje xtoḻa'le, perw coža'na' za' yid ben' gon cont soa Spiritw c̱he Diosen' ḻo' yic̱hjlažda'olen' ṉabian' le'e. Na' beṉe' ca' bi yeson can' chazlaže' Diosen', seḻe' ḻegaque' ḻo yi' gabiḻen'. Na' ben' za' za' coža'na' zaca'che' ca neda' na' da' nacchgüe' beṉe' zaca', bi zaca' gona' xmandadoe' ḻec̱hja' no xele'.

Benan' gone' len beṉac̱hen' can' choncho cate' chdecho trigon' ḻo' rner. Chotobcho trigon' chgo'ošagüe'chon na' chzeycho yix beben'. Na' beṉe' bi chesejnilaže' Diosen', seḻe' ḻegaque' ḻo yi' gabiḻen' dan' cbi cheyol chenit.
Na' gwza' Jesúsen' gan' mbane Galilea na' gwyeje' gan' zoa Juanṉa' cho'a yegw Jordánṉa' cont Juanṉa' bzoe' ḻe' nis.
Na' Juanṉa' ben cho'alagüe' gague goclaže' gwzoe' Jesúsen' nis, gože'ne': ―Chyažjda' gwzo' neda' nisen' na' le' zedeṉabo' gwzoa' le' nis.
Nach Jesúsen' gože' Juanṉa': ―Bzoa neda' nisen'. Cheyaḻa' goncho ca' cont gac yogo'ḻoḻ dan' non Diosen' mandadw gac. Nach gwc̱heb Juanṉa' bzoe'ne' nis.
Na' cate' beyož gwzoa Jesúsen' nisen', bechoje' ḻo' nisen', na' ḻa' byaljwte yaban' gan' zoa Diosen'. Na' ble'ede' Spiritw c̱he Diosen' betjen ca to ngolbex na' bžinen gwzoan len ḻe'.
Na' gosende' gwṉe Dios ben' zoa yaban', gwne': ―Bengan' Xi'iṉa' beṉe' chacda' na' chebe chezaquelaže'chgüeda' c̱he'.
